messages:
leah: Quick spin-up thread for follow-ups from the security segment in today's all-hands (SOC2/ISO, VPC/private deploys, audit logs, KMS). Keep them short and we'll triage.

omar: First Q: customers asking if we can provide evidence of KMS HSM backing for Hosted. What's the official stance?

vivian: Hosted uses cloud-provider KMS by default (no customer HSM). We can provide a cryptographic architecture note but Hosted CMK/HSM is not GA. Dedicated/Private support CMK with HSM on enterprise plans.

leah: Timeline question: is there an ETA for Hosted BYOK/HSM support?

dave: Short: aiming for an opt-in beta in Q4; GA depends on enterprise uptake and compliance gating. No firm date yet.

omar: VPC peering vs private agent: which should we pitch to large regulated customers?

vivian: Private agent or Transit Gateway recommended for complex networks. VPC peering is supported for simpler setups. Private agent gives more control and is easier for audit evidence collection.

security-bot: Reminder: SOC2 evidence checklist v0.2 will be posted to the compliance channel on Friday.

leah: Audit logs retention — hosted default and options for Dedicated/Private?

dave: Hosted default 90 days. Dedicated/Private configurable up to 365, and Private can stream logs to customer SIEMs.

ovar: (typo) meant 'omar' — thanks. Any per-request PII redaction in logs?

vivian: We redact request bodies by default for sensitive fields in Hosted, but customers can enable full payload logging in Dedicated/Private if their legal/risk team approves.

leah: OK action items: Vivian to publish a short customer-facing one-pager on BYOK & HSM status; Dave to post VPC checklist; Security to drop SOC2 checklist. Ping this thread when live.Thanks everyone. :pray:
